description:
Workspace sweep follow-up to bd:JMAP-qz9v.35 (contacts-server, just closed) and bd:JMAP-ic0j.32/.69 (calendars-server, original canonical).

LOCATION: crate-jmap-tasks-server/src/memory.rs:328-353

CURRENT IMPL:
```rust
pub fn seed_object(
    &self,
    account_id: &str,
    type_name: &'static str,
    id: &str,
    value: serde_json::Value,
) {
    let mut inner = self.inner.lock().unwrap();
    inner.known_accounts.insert(account_id.to_owned());
    // ... (no type_name validation, no value-shape validation)
}
```

PROBLEM: tasks-server's seed_object accepts any serde_json::Value without:
1. Validating type_name is one of the known TaskList / Task / TaskNotification literals — a typo silently corrupts the fixture into a dead namespace.
2. Validating value is an object with an `id` field equal to the id arg — a malformed fixture surfaces much later as opaque MemoryError("deserialize ...") from get_objects, far from the seed call site.

Same finding as bd:JMAP-qz9v.35 on contacts-server. Both crates had identical pre-fix shape, both inherit the gap from a pre-validation-pattern era. calendars-server already has the validation per bd:JMAP-ic0j.32 / .69; the contacts-server fix landing now ports that pattern.

PROPAGATE: port the contacts-server fix verbatim, substituting the two known type names `TaskList` / `Task` / `TaskNotification` (three for tasks, two for contacts). Add the same 6 unit tests (4 #[should_panic] + 2 positive controls). Relax type_name parameter from `&'static str` to `&str` (matching calendars + contacts).

The contacts-server tests at crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/memory.rs in mod seed_object_validation_tests are the direct template.

NO production callers — seed_object is test-fixture-only API gated behind feature='memory'.

P3 because the failure mode is wasted test-debug time, not runtime bug. Same priority as the related sibling-sweep bead bd:JMAP-v7c9 for README Gotchas wording.
title: tasks-server seed_object: port validation pattern from calendars/contacts canonical
